display_long_description:
SubLiminal Slop is a multiplayer VR horror game built for the Meta Quest where players explore a long-abandoned underground research facility,  and go through a variety of liminal spaces.

Using immersive VR movement and proximity voice chat, you and your team must navigate dark corridors, forgotten laboratories, and unstable cave systems while searching for a way out.

But you are not alone.

Players must work together to:

Explore multiple environments including facility halls, backrooms, and underground caves. Avoid deadly creatures that hunt players in different ways. Communicate and survive using proximity voice chat. Escape the depths before it’s too late. Every run is unpredictable. Every sound matters. 

And every level takes you deeper into the SubLiminal. Just remember...

Some levels should stay sealed.
